title: StudioBrain Community Plugin Entry
description: Schema for a single WASM-component plugin entry in plugins/index.json. Community plugins are wasm-component only (hello-world-community may still declare runtime=wasm as a placeholder).

id.description: Globally unique plugin identifier. Use author-plugin-slug format.

name.description: Human-readable display name for the plugin.

version.description: Semver version of the plugin entry. Must match the version of the hosted WASM bundle.

description.description: Short description of what the plugin does. Max 200 characters.

author.description: Author name, GitHub username, or organization name.

repo_url.description: URL to the plugin source repository.

wasm_bundle_url.description: Direct HTTPS URL to the .wasm component bundle. Empty string only for unpublished placeholders.

sha256.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the WASM bundle. Empty only when wasm_bundle_url is empty.

runtime.description: Must be wasm-component. The hello-world-community placeholder may use wasm.

tags.description: Searchable tags for the plugin. Maximum 5.

min_version.description: Minimum StudioBrain version required to run this plugin.

license.description: SPDX license identifier for the plugin.
